title: Ecuador's indigenous movement: the CONAIE and the 1990 uprising
goal: Retell what people said about the CONAIE and its uprisings, shifting time and place words.
grammar: shifting time and place words in reported speech

items: I can retell what someone said, shifting the time and place words (*ese día*, *el día anterior*, *allí*).
I can say what the CONAIE is and what happened in 1990.
I can use the new words for the movement: *levantamiento*, *nacionalidad*, *plurinacional*, *combustible*.
